name: Nested calibration of native-propensity-matched span updates and a new randomized two-path training panel
training: Use only sessions 1–4 and existing historical rule-2 signals on six training dialogues. For every held dialogue, train only on the other five. All signed action labels are the same verified rule-2 signals as the parent actor. Calibrate the size of the update on fully matched actual two-branch outcomes, without creating new credit on unresolved questions.
actor: Fit the same regularized three-source-feature credit actor on each fitting subset. Use standardized source features times slopes, drop the intercept, clamp to [-2,2]. Add lambda times the resulting correction to the actual native logit. For each lambda in [0,.25,.5,1,2], recalibrate one intercept on fitting states to match the native mean probability. For the five inner held dialogues compute mean paired F1 gain over native (equal measured spans within each dialogue). Require at least three positive dialogue gains and a positive mean minus one across-dialogue standard error. Pick largest mean minus SE, ties smaller lambda; otherwise lambda=0. Retrain on all five other dialogues. Fixed lambda=1 and lambda=0 are ablations. Both probabilities and greedy choices use the same pre-action features; native logit may depend on the realized previous action.
cohort: All disjoint complete two-session windows starting at 9,11,... containing at least one standard non-adversarial question with all annotated evidence in the window, from six training dialogues. Include every eligible question; no formal-development or test histories. Balance pivot and background action by shuffling blocks of four assignments separately per dialogue before seeing any model outputs. Round-robin over dialogues as generation proceeds.
randomization: Each window receives one pivot (first or second) and one fixed background action (temporal or activity). Observe both true full trajectories with the pivot set to either action. Inclusion probability of any given two-action trajectory across randomizations is 1/2, including tail blocks. A window is complete only after both paths, source hashes, score recomputation and appropriate common-prefix checks.
estimands: Primary: question-weighted paired gain (p_focal - p_native_focal)*(F1_activity-F1_temporal) with the other action fixed by design. Secondary: two-step policy value and paired difference via Horvitz-Thompson (twice sum of observed path masses times F1), also report normalized weight ratio, sampling mass, greedy, fixed skills, native, terminal, original source, component-filtered credit and within-window permutation of corrections. Compare fixed unit step and calibrated step. Aggregate by training dialogue, type and pivot; report six-dialogue descriptive paired bootstrap. Require +.02 over native and terminal, improved placement versus shuffled and credit ablations, positive in four dialogues to justify independent development. These training windows are not an independent official test.
